content.label:
I tried using this app but it would not allow me to use any features until I was redirected to their website and signed up with their plan. You get two weeks free but I think this is shady since most people might forget to cancel.

Instantly deleting since I have no way to preview the app. Give me a free option without logging into your website and selecting a plan.

After about 20 min of trying to get the app to work I was left stuck with the focus@will banner on an otherwise blank screen. Though the menu had my credentials input it still repeatedly asked me to sign in and yet wouldn't play. I find it ironic that an app aimed at created focus creates so much distraction.

The breadth of songs is not that big and does not warrant $50 a year.  I dropped it after a year.  It's nice but I can get similar concentration music with a well crafted search on my on demand music streaming service.  (Google play, iTunes, etc.)
Their server is too small to support their app or website. Crashes every 10-15 minutes. Hard. Until they upgrade, skip this product.
This has been a mainstay in my lineup to perform better.  Wouldn't know what to do without it.  Way better than any Spotify focus playlist.

title.label: Online is awesome, app is horrible!

content.label: Focus@will online is awesome. The app is frustrating. It doesn't log me in. Each time it looks like I'm in, it sends me back to the login screen. I would recommend they ditch the app until it works. Stick to using it online.

Not honest folks.  Had signed up for the free p version which had certain limitations but did not expire.  Now the app tells me to pound sand and pay $12 bucks a month.  Unimpressed with their product & put off by their business practices.  They're doomed, rightly so.
Excellent app. Tried others ... this is the best I have encountered. Makes a real difference in my productivity, which is CRITICAL as an entrepreneur.

I liked the idea for the few hours I was able to use it.  I signed up for the free trial.  I noticed some pauses after the first couple of hours.  I assumed it was my internet connection, but then it stopped all together and simply showed "focus@will" on the screen.  I deleted the app, then restarted my phone and reinstalled it.  All I get is the "focus@will" graphic now and this just in the first day of use.  Huge disappointment.
The research that went into the science behind this app is amazing. I love to use this app, and I also use it on my desktop.

I have a long habit of listening to non-intrusive background music while I work. I can't concentrate with music with many lyrics so have always listened to instrumental playlists. Focus@will meets this need perfectly for me. Much appreciated and well worth the few $$ per year. 👍🏻

In the past I sometimes have had difficulty focusing. With this program I am able to focus better and longer. I have been using this program for more than a year and is satisfied!
My only wish is that I could access this service without needing to be connected to the Internet.
I use this app every day to be much more productive and focused. Good design, easy to use, and I actually really like the music they choose too!
All my focus needs on the go!

I was contacted to try out this app, and for my responses I would recieve 60 days to use the app for free. AWESOME.......until the app no longer will let me access. I go online to access through the website, and same thing.
I have contacted customer service with no reply in over 48 hours. I sign in, it flashes the player for a second, ask to sign in again, i sign in, and it goes to a page with the words focus@will on top and nothing happens. Keeps going in this loop and the frustrating thing is when I see the player, it says HI ZACHARY< you have 44 days left on your account. If there was some way to make the employees....focus.

Love using this app. It definitely helps calm the mind and focus on the task. Found it productive at many instances. The new facelift to the app looks better. Great concept and work! A must try app for those who get distracted easily in the digital world

title.label: Well worth it with the discount

content.label:
I previously wrote a lukewarm review for this service, as I really like it but felt like paying close to $8/month was too much. Turns out they occasionally offer discounts of even 50%, which puts the cost within a more reasonable range.

I use this almost daily as part of my writing ritual. I continue to be skeptical of the "science" behind it, but it has really worked wonders for me. Somehow, even when I was reluctant to use it, I found that the moment I started playing my favorite playlist (cinematic) I would immediately go into writing more. I will keep using it for now!
I like the service on my laptop but the app won't even open on my phone. Not compatible with iOS 10 perhaps?

The subscription rate for this app is ridiculous, especially considering I can do the exact same thing on Pandora for a cheaper subscription and I get more music playlists. I enjoyed my 15 day free trial but I can't fathom why people are paying for this.

title.label: Not free while there're soo many free sources

content.label: paid for literally nothing

I generally like the app, but after the free trial it's too expensive. The guy wants $7.99 a month. Apple Music is only $9.99 a month and give me access to the entire iTunes catalog! Dude is charging way too much. I'd personally be willing to pay a maximum of one or two dollars a month with maybe a discount for an annual plan for $10 a year.
App description says 30 days but actual period is 15 days...

This app is just awful. Crashes all the time, random bugs, it's just terrible.

Dear developer:
Why don't you actually test the app on an iPhone. Like, test your app before releasing it? Not exactly PHD level CompSci...
I just signed up and you show me with a 15 day free trial, not a 30 day trial as you state in your app description. Why is that? Also Support does not work.

Liked this when we first got it
Now all the tracks are scratchy, and although I keep clicking "support" it just takes me back to the app, with no way to contact technical support- even thru App support from App Store, just takes me to a blank page I cannot type on or o to the app with NO SUPPORT! Have uninstalled and reinstalled at least once
Where the hell are these people?
Works with some finagling.

title.label: Useful App That Does One Thing Exceptionally Well

content.label: I continue to renew my paid subscription to their awesome service year after year ever since first discovering this incredible focus tool. As a creative person who's easily distracted & has about 5,299,430 new ideas every minute, I've found this particular app in addition to their web service highly useful. The choices of sounds & music are quite varied; I always find something to suit whatever mood I'm in & the tempo I need. If you need help focusing at all, I cannot recommend this app enough! And spring for the paid service - it's totally worth it. They deserve every penny.
Great studying music! kind of outdated player... But still functions fine

title.label: The music works; the app needs work

content.label:
First, yes, the music does what is advertised. No question about that.

$11+/month seems pricey to me.  Even $9.99 seems stiff.

Like others, I see lots of room for improvement for the app that hasn't been updated in a year.

1. Better buffering for slower connections

2. Reduce the data usage

3. An offline option would be great.

4. Put all the app options on the app

Bruce

This app works as expected. It changes up music in an intelligent way as to keep your mind from wandering. I'm a fan of that. What I'm not sold on is the price. The amount you expect me to pay for something like this is unreasonably high for the product. I would love to use it, but the creators behind this app need to recognize that they are expecting far too much for so little in return. Cut the price by more than half and I'll considering signing up for it. But until then, $12 a month is ludicrous.

App is super buggy sadly-
On my phone anyway!
 I have tried numerous times to contact customer service through the app with no success. They offer a 30 Day moneyback guarantee it however I can't get through to them I have tried to email but with no reply.
There are channels on Pandora and Spotify that have spa/ambient music plus they offer much more for less money.

title.label: Best App for Getting Things Done!

content.label: Better than Evernote, To Do List, and Wunderlist... I have used every productivity app to help me get my to-do's done, to stay focused, and finish what I set out to achieve, and this App has the magic - neuro-music on a timer! Brilliant! Huge props to the geniuses behind the app and curating the best experiences to improving productivity. Now, not only do I get my writing and actions items done.... it is actually fun!

title.label: If it can keep me focused...

content.label: Listening to the radio gets me singing along with the songs. Commercials distract me. This app gives me some amazing background sounds and keeps me productive.  Thank you!

The app is poorly designed so unfortunately while the music is good, I give it a poor rating. The app still is designed for older iPhones, times out frequently if it isn't in the foreground, and links in the app open Safari to a webpage that says it will open content back in the app but which do not work when they refocus to the app (and further kill the music since the app was taken out of the foreground).

For 12 dollars a month I'd expect the app to be updated and see bugs fixed. Not for now.

Great music lists and definitely helps concentration. I like that skipping songs helps the playlist continue to refine itself. Good selection of different types of music. Only downside: would like to be able to play it when no wifi available.

title.label: Relies too much on internet connection

content.label: The app is great for gaining and sustaining focus but it heavily relies on your internet connection. I think paying subscribers should be able to use it offline and uninterrupted by a poor connection as well as the absence of it. Without this problem, it will no doubt be a five star app. Please address this because it defeats the app's purpose.
Only thing that I would like to see is a version or a feature that would allow you to play the music while on airplane mode. I would pay for this.
I don't understand why such an app would require you to log in every time. When I forgot my password I can't recover it either. Never got the pw recover email! Sorry it is useless.

Have been streaming a little over a year. Addicted to the alpha chill station (only one that gets me in the zone). My only critique is that I listened to this station so much that I ran out of songs (when you skip a song it is removed from your rotation). I filed a ticket with support today and was informed within a couple hours that they introduced a feature to reset skips and were adding more songs to alpha chill. Very satisfied customer!
You can't pause and continue on the same song, you can't choose what song you want, and you can't open the support page.

This really helped me focus. I use it when i'm feeling harried and distracted and i am better able to focus on the mountains of paperwork i am tasked with. Also, mundane tasks feel less arduous. Judging by other reviews, some people don't realize that this is music that has been engineered or designed to increase concentration and not just the regular fare that is on Spotify or Pandora. They are paying for the enhancements. You need to make this clearer in your explanation of what the product is.

Even when closed this app uses enormous battery power. I go from full charge to 50% in an hour. Tried cleaning junk and memory and restarting phone, but that doesn't resolve the problem. Only deleting the app restored my battery time to normal. Went through this process twice to be sure that it was only this app that was the problem, because I liked it.  Unfortunate that it has this problem, or else it would be good.

I have had the service for a few months and I've tried many different settings, all different levels and all different types of sounds.. It makes absolutely no difference in terms of my concentration & is actually quite distracting and makes it harder to do work.. I'm not sure what all the reviews are talking about. Also, the company will not refund the money and locks you into a one year expensive contract after the 30 day... Even if you are not happy & get zero benefit from the product. They also have automatic renewal and continue to charge your credit card or iTunes account. I highly recommend to stay away and just order a CD if you're looking for this type of product (or have a cup of coffee).
I can't get the App to stay open on my iPod. It opens and then immediately closes. I can't find out if this would be helpful or not.

title.label: Using over a year and love it

content.label: Essential app for focus.  When I need to study but don't want to sit in silence this little app sees me through.  Discovered it when I met the founder at a Singularity University gathering.  Former member of the Eurythmics.  He stripped out the attention sapping parts of music.  The voice and drums and inconsistencies.  Works well for study and focus time.  Does what it says on the box and worth the money in saved attention aka quality time.

It worked great until  it expired purchases another month and bam it's looping saying error error please re load and nothing and I can't get a refund F THESE GUYS UNLESS UOU GIVE ME REFUND OR MAKE THE APP WORK PROPERLY
... when I need to get serious work done.  I don't know what their magic sauce is, but I can focus better than with any of my (extensive) playlists.

I use this constantly, and it helps me get right into the zone when I'm working. I also like it for just having on in the background as white noise when I'm doing mundane tasks or meditating. I haven't noticed any bugginess with my iPad, but I have an older model with OS 6.1.3.
I get distracted easily. This app allows me to stay more on task.
